decisions.reason: As a thermoforming blank for dental use, it is very close to the firm's existing materials-processing knowledge and its continued standalone presentation suggests enough market feedback to justify further refinement rather than withdrawal.
A PETG thermoforming blank sits squarely in the firm's core polymer and sheet-processing capabilities, so the firm can readily absorb customer feedback and improve it with existing know-how.

The UV-curing lacquer is a more adjacent specialty product with lower visibility, but it still builds on related chemical and application knowledge that a large established manufacturer can exploit commercially.

Custom hearing-protection earmolds are somewhat more service- and niche-intensive, yet the fact that this offering remained while another earmold line disappeared suggests the firm sees enough fit with its accumulated audiology and custom-manufacturing knowledge to retain it for now.
